06fc3ba9.text:
"The skyseer elders among the Windshapers, by contrast, place implicit trust in the wind spirits and regard any questioning of their designs as an affront to our benefactors. They hold that our patrons in Skywall have already sacrificed much to bring us here and sustain us. They assert that if any further knowledge was vital to our survival, they would surely reveal it in due course. This difference in belief has given rise to no small measure of tension between the two orders.

Whatever the truth may be, it is plain that we are not alone in this realm, and that many mysteries yet remain beyond our present understanding."
06fc3ba9.title: On The Windlord

0abdf1b9.text:
"Much of the flora and fauna of the $R Isles has been shaped by the elemental forces that reign here in the realm of Skywall. Many creatures once bound to the earth now bear avian traits such as beaks, talons, and feathers. Others have gained the power of flight, though such transformations remain less common than other outward changes.

Among the shen'dorei, the elemental plane's influence upon the body has been gradual and subtle. Yet in recent generations its effects have grown increasingly dramatic. Consider, for instance, the phenomenon now commonly called the "Sky-Touched Blessing."
0abdf1b9.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

1f91b566.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"On The Windlord."
1f91b566.title: On The Windlord

43567f4a.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Rebellion in Eldre'Thalas, Part 1"
43567f4a.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

43567f4b.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Rebellion in Eldre'Thalas, Part 2"
43567f4b.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

49795015.text: "Of late, the magisters of the High Order have grown increasingly wary of the wind spirits' motives, insisting that all powers and perils native to this realm must be better understood. Even if such dangers lie far from us now, the magisters maintain that such knowledge will better prepare us to face whatever may yet come."
49795015.title: On The Windlord

7de002ed.text:
"I will continue to serve our people here on Zephras, and I will devote much of my time to furthering our relationship with the wind spirits to whom we owe so much. The elemental spirits are wondrous and wise, and we still have so much to learn from one another.

I am devoted to seeing the shen'dorei persevere in this beautiful and strange realm--and to seeing that we do so freely, justly, and unshackled by tyranny."
7de002ed.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

7e23fcfc.text:
"The young Prince Tortheldrin intended to build a network of crystalline foci and use them to siphon and shape a new font of power for our people to draw upon. The point of contention for many was that he intended to use the very power that nearly destroyed our world to accomplish this. He meant to siphon this power from a demon world within the Twisting Nether itself. 

Many rightly feared this could open a new door through which demonic entities might gain once again access to our world."
7e23fcfc.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

8a3468e3.text: "Whatever the truth may be, our benefactors clearly have no wish to speak of Al'Akir or his servants, and they are quick to dismiss all rumors of the Windlord's presence as idle fancy, unworthy of serious heed. They assure us that we need not trouble ourselves with such matters here, safe upon our $R Isles. While this offers solemn comfort to many, it also raises a troubling question: what, precisely, are the wind spirits concealing from us?"
8a3468e3.title: On The Windlord

914ded86.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Sky-Touched Mystery"
914ded86.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

96213f45.text:
"It's well documented since our ascent to Skywall that our people have adopted more lithe, slender forms, but this occurred over the course of many millennia. In contrast, the first recorded case of the Sky-Touched Blessing--which causes shen'dorei children to be born with vivid cerulean skin--was noted fewer than five generations ago.

Within a single generation of its first appearance, one child in twenty born among the $R bore this curious alteration. Two generations later, that rate had doubled."
96213f45.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

9d55873f.text:
"With the founding of our new home here in the clouds, we embark on a new age of peace and prosperity for our people.

You have all endured so much to make it here. I have watched our people grow into a hardy, self-reliant society, which fills me with a pride I cannot hope to describe in full.

The greatest part of that pride, however, is that it has become clear to me that I no longer have any need to act as our singular ruler."
9d55873f.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

a3f989c8.text:
"Today, three in ten children born on the $R Isles have the striking complexion of the Sky-Touched. In recent centuries, the acceleration of our physical alterations has increased, and many scholars believe that the last vestiges of our kaldorei heritage may vanish entirely within two to three more generations.

The cause of this transformation may never be fully understood. Yet it is plain that, in making our lives within the elemental plane, we as a people are being changed by it in turn. Skywall is a realm of wonders, but this serves as a sober reminder that we still know perilously little of what such a place may work upon those not born to it."
a3f989c8.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

ac4eb085.text: "Thank you for everything you've sacrificed, everything you've built, and everything you've taught me about how to be a better person. You all represent the unshakable resolve of the shen'dorei people. We will thrive in this beautiful new world and reach new heights together."
ac4eb085.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

accca090.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"An excerpt from the Shal'nan's speech at the groundbreaking ceremony for the Shrine of the Four Winds, Zephras Isle."
accca090.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

ad70f374.text:
"Prince Tortheldrin grew frustrated, fearing that delays and debate would lead to the further deterioration of his kingdom. 

As a result, his response to this resistance was swift and brutal. Over the course of a single bloody night, a purge was carried out that saw the complete destruction of dozens of noble houses. All who publicly opposed Tortheldrin were abruptly silenced, and entire lineages were destroyed overnight."
ad70f374.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

cb9a9530.text:
"The terror of such brazen suppression caused a shocked silence to fall over the people of Eldre'Thalas. All discourse around Prince Tortheldrin's plan abruptly ceased... for a time, at least. Unfortunately for the Prince, the harder tyrants squeeze their people, the brighter the flames of resistance burn.

There were those who resolved to ensure our people did not repeat Queen Azshara's mistakes. A group of scholars formerly of the order of the Shen'dralar met in secret and formed a pact. Swearing to stop the Prince by any means necessary, they began to plant the seeds of rebellion."
cb9a9530.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

e02ca2f0.text:
"Who is Al'Akir the Windlord? The priests of the radical Al'Aketh would have us believe him to be the true ruler of Skywall, the realm we now call home. In their telling, we are but interlopers here, and one day Al'Akir shall appear before us to reckon with our trespass into his dominion within the elemental plane.

Though such claims may at first seem the ravings of the misguided or the mad, there may yet be some measure of truth in them. When asked of Al'Akir's nature, the wind spirits grow evasive and agitated. Indeed, even the mere speaking of the so-called "Windlord's" name appears to cause them profound unease, perhaps even fear."
e02ca2f0.title: On The Windlord

f0de76e9.text: "There were those who loudly opposed the Prince's plan to channel a font of demonic energy to power his network of crystalline foci. Many of the detractors were members of outspoken noble families who attempted to use their influence to turn public sentiment against House Tortheldrin and the Prince's plan."
f0de76e9.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

f2713b07.text:
"Thus, I am abdicating my position as your leader and handing over governance of our $R Isles to a carefully chosen council of provincial elders. After the transition period is over, you will have the opportunity to choose your own leaders, and your voices will determine the direction we take from here on. 

You have demonstrated the ability to lead yourselves better than any king, queen, prince, or other individual sovereign ever could--and that fills me with profound pride."
f2713b07.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

f581396b.text:
Brother Haalien,

It is time to prove your worth to the Al'Aketh! Go into Shadowgale to find the pylon. You have conveyed your concerns about the druids and the highest in our order have heard you.

Take these faithful soldiers with you in your righteous mission. Kill the druids swiftly lest they interfere with our plans. We have eyes and ears in Valanaar that will confirm when you have been successful.

The time of reckoning is at hand! None shall be able to stop the ushering!

-N
f581396b.title: Mysterious Orders

fa484bc7.text: "After the climax of the war and the Great Sundering of Kalimdor, the new reality of a world bereft of the sustaining magic on which our people depended quickly became apparent. The ruling house of Eldre'Thalas--House Tortheldrin--rapidly set plans in motion to ensure stability and continuity of our way of life. However, the methods they intended to employ left many deeply concerned."
fa484bc7.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

ff2a2345.text: "In the days immediately following the turmoil at the Well of Eternity, there was much unrest in Eldre'Thalas. The demonic forces that poured from the Well nearly overwhelmed the beleaguered elvish kingdoms, ravaging the land and killing indiscriminately. If not for the intervention of the demigod Goldrinn and the sacrifice of countless kaldorei heroes, the kingdom of Eldre'Thalas would surely have been overrun and destroyed."
ff2a2345.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

233|f729d74e.name: Farmer Saldean
233|f729d74e.text: Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|6928abbf.name: John Burnside
2457|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251684|3fc9c33a.name: Strange Hermit
251684|3fc9c33a.text:
Oh, these things? I built them. My little friends helped me. I'm not very good at remembering things, but, um, I do know that at one point I used to build a lot of things. Big things! But then, like I said... I was here. The things I build aren't so big and impressive anymore. Still makes me h-happy, heh.

B-but... If you want, I can show you how to build things too!

251684|5d8faa22.name: Strange Hermit
251684|5d8faa22.text: H-Hello. You'll have to excuse me, I'm used to your kind running from me.

251684|f390af9b.name: Strange Hermit
251684|f390af9b.text:
That is... a very good question. I have a hard time remembering things, but I do remember something... "Engineer", perhaps? I think that's what, or who, I was.

Other than that, all I can seem to remember is soaring through the sky, then seeing a flash of lightning before things got very bumpy. Then... a crash.

It's been... a long time though. A very long time.

251902|f56638d6.name: Illaya Amberwind
251902|f56638d6.text:
Greetings, child. I am Illaya Amberwind and I am the Elder Windshaper here on Zephras Isle. It's always nice to meet young new faces that make their way down from the grove.

Don't let this old shaman hold you up, no doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Do feel free to stop by later if you'd like.

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251992|f5ff5fa7.name: Fenn Fairweather
251992|f5ff5fa7.text: Welcome to Shen'dar Village, some of the best fishing this side of the mountain range. If you are looking to catch fish, I can teach you, for a price.

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252377|caa7ddf7.name: Seena Skybreaker
252377|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

253004|fb513610.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

254151|197a65c0.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|197a65c0.text: The Nightclaw do not take kindly to reckless intruders. Tread carefully while in Shadowgale, $c.

254151|20a1483e.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|20a1483e.text:
You've earned a degree of trust amongst the Nightclaw, $c. We don't have much to offer you as a reward, but we have managed to scavenge a number of crafting plans from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

The magesmiths of Ban'aethal were widely regarded to be the best artisans in all of the $R Isles. The Nightclaw are naturalists, not crafters, so these records are of little use to us.

Continue to prove yourself to be a valuable ally, and I would make these secrets available to you.

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257944|37940c1f.name: Elegael Thornpaw
257944|37940c1f.text: I cannot believe we were taken by surprise by the Al'Aketh. They have never been hostile to us before, but with their ambush they injured many of my kin. I swear I will get revenge for the fallen and wounded druids of my den. Mark my words, they will pay.

258130|5a52f936.name: Jorel Windsinger
258130|5a52f936.text:
<Before you lies the corpse of Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succumbing to his wounds.>

259012|517aef13.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
259012|517aef13.text: All of the $r islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

259013|6750d3f2.name: Resaan Nimbuswalker
259013|6750d3f2.text:
<Before you lies a $r; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half-filled crate nearby lies spilled on the ground.>

259084|637067e7.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|637067e7.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow $R quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

272045|5a3e1b84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|5a3e1b84.text:
Why are you looking at me like that? Do you expect me to shoot bolts of lightning at you, or threaten you with the wrath of the Windlord?

It's fair enough if you do. However, not all of us are quite so... zealous.

275269|d9943d35.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|d9943d35.text: Board here for transport to Dalaran City, nestled in the Alterac Mountains.

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5480|c3d2f0f0.name: Ilsa Corbin
5480|c3d2f0f0.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

6089|122548b3.name: Harry Burlguard
6089|122548b3.text:
It takes more than a big arm and a mean look to be a $c.  You also need a clear head and a sharp eye if you want to stay alive.

And bad breath doesn't hurt either.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

914|c3d2f0f0.name: Ander Germaine
914|c3d2f0f0.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1638-complete.name: Harry Burlguard
1638-complete.text:
Oh ho!  Have a drink with me, lass.  You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!

Or... were you here for a lesson?
1638-complete.title: A Warrior's Training

1665-progress.name: Harry Burlguard
1665-progress.text: I saw your fight with Bartleby.  Nicely done!  Did you get his mug?
1665-progress.title: Bartleby's Mug

1667-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
1667-progress.text: Do you have my badge? I don't want to think of the mischief Dead-tooth Jack could cause with it.
1667-progress.title: Dead-tooth Jack

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

92741-progress.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
92741-progress.text: The High Order do not make it a habit to employ themselves as simple trappers and game wardens, but when performing a service such as this can lead to scholarly gain, we are happy to engage in acts of community service.
92741-progress.title: Unwelcome Visitors
